Freeze external full organism, not open tulip petals. Calyx occupies z.11-.22m, maximum radius.035m, slightly six-lobed. Stem outer sleeve tapers and ends above low bulbous flattened holdfast, inner stem continues to holdfast. Shell has real thickness and six rectangular-oval inset through-openings with inner wall; terminal anus smaller than basal calyx width. No invented external arms/tentacles. Topology unseen rear repeats same coherent sixfold plan. Opaque external surface hides internal organs without claiming absence.
